Crew-13 is launching to the space station 400 km above Earth tomorrow
caption:
Crew-13 is launching to the International Space Station as early as October 1st, carrying 4 astronauts on a 6-month mission 400 km above Earth.

The ISS has been continuously occupied since November 2000. Every 6 months a new crew rotates in, and the handoff has to work perfectly so the station never goes dark. Most people have no idea it is still happening.
